sources.title: Lao PDR official legal-information portal: Law on Entry and Exit
sources.officialityEvidence: The Lao PDR official legal-information portal publishes the Law on Entry and Exit, which assigns the Ministry of Foreign Affairs the function of issuing ordinary passports to Lao PDR citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Issue, cancel or withdraw ... ordinary passports and other travel documents of citizens of the Lao PDR.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal states the national tourist-entry rule, names the visa-exempt Chinese-national exception and directs tourist applicants to eVisaCuba.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory to enter Cuba if you do not have Cuban residency. ... Tourist visas via internet ... evisacuba.cu.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Foreign Affairs: advice for travellers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration and the Diaspora, Côte d'Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Côte d'Ivoire MFA traveller guidance sets the visitor document baseline and directs visitors to the SNEDAI visa route or a conditional airport-visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passeport valide plus de 6 mois et visa requis (demande en ligne via le portail officiel de Snedai ou visa aéroportuaire sous conditions).

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as Côte d'Ivoire's only State-approved visa-application website, limits the online process to valid ordinary-passport holders, and states that the visa is printed and issued at the airport after approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La demande en ligne du E-visa est valable uniquement pour les détenteurs de passeports ordinaires.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: entry regime for Lao citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's current nationality-and-travel-document entry table expressly records Laos as requiring a visa, including an e-Visa.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: e-Visa issuance resumed for foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's current announcement confirms that the Ministry resumed issuing electronic visas from 19 February 2025, so the named Laos e-Visa route in its entry table is an operative electronic route rather than a historical portal reference.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Starting from February 19, 2025, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine resumes the issuance of electronic visas.

policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Lao visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available online.
conditions: Use an ordinary Lao PDR passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a Lao ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Lao ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d’Ivoire's current MFA guidance requires visitors to hold a visa, and its official ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a valid Lao ordinary passport. Complete SNEDAI pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d’Ivoire official visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the Lao ordinary-passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 F5A service makes an online tourism eVisa available to citizens of all countries and sends the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use a valid Lao ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket, hotel or host evidence and sufficient funds. The F5A route is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.

Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The Nigeria Immigration Service document says the applicant receives the visa certificate by email; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the Lao ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Ukraine electronic visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's current country table expressly lists Laos as requiring a visa including an e-Visa, and the Ministry confirms the electronic-visa service resumed in February 2025.
conditions: Use an ordinary Lao PDR passport. Ukraine MFA's current nationality table expressly lists Laos as ‘visa, including e-Visa’; choose an e-Visa category for which the purpose and documents qualify.

Obtain the e-Visa before travel through Ukraine's official electronic-visa service. The service resumed on 19 February 2025; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.
War-related border and air-access rules, occupied-territory permits, work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Ukraine MFA e-Visa service
steps: Apply for an eligible e-Visa category using the Lao ordinary passport before travel.
Use the issued electronic visa with the supporting documents required for that category.
Check current border, carrier and final-admission requirements before departure.
